description: Fix stream sentinel detection to use structural JSON parsing instead of string containment, eliminating the exploitable collision class
steps: 1. In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py event_stream() generator, replace the string containment check with JSON parsing
2. Strip SSE prefix, attempt JSON parse, and check for sentinel key in the parsed dict
3. If JSON parse fails or event is not a dict with the sentinel key, yield normally
4. Verify the file parses correctly with Python AST
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel detection parses JSON structurally rather than using string containment
Normal text events are yielded unchanged
Sentinel events are captured correctly (full_response and actual_model extracted)
Malformed JSON events are yielded as normal (not swallowed)
Python AST parse of chat.py passes
verification: cd apps/backend && python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('app/api/v1/chat.py').read()); print('AST parse OK')"
